facts.statement: A special 5M Party Wheel was available for a limited time to celebrate the 5,000,000th registered Free Realms player, and players could log in daily to spin it.
facts.quote: a special 5M Party Wheel is available for a limited time

facts.statement: To take part, players had to log in to Free Realms during the event window of September 16, 2009 to September 23, 2009.
facts.quote: you must log in to Free Realms between September 16, 2009 and September 23, 2009

article_summaries.title: 5 Million Celebration Event - Limited Time Only
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post announces a limited-time 5M Party Wheel event celebrating the 5,000,000th registered Free Realms player. Players who logged in between September 16 and September 23, 2009 could spin the wheel daily for party-themed virtual rewards. The post's date is inferred from the capture date and its relative 'posted 6 days, 3 hours ago' stamp.
